'''''Pawp''''' was a billboard [[Painting/Legends|advertisement]] for the video store of the same name. A series of such advertisements were put up in the streets near [[Jackar Bowmani's apartment/Legends|Jackar Bowmani's apartment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Sabotage" /> The ad featured a multi-[[Color/Legends|colored]] background, with the words "[[Video store/Legends|VIDEO STORE]]" printed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters at the top, and the name "[[Pawp/Legends|PAWP]]" running vertically down the billboard.<ref name="Sabotage" />
